laws.name: Illinois Paid Leave for All Workers Act
laws.description: Provides paid leave for any reason, including medical needs, family caregiving, or personal time. Applies to most employers statewide.

laws.name: Illinois Paid Family and Medical Leave (Effective 2026)
laws.description: Provides paid leave benefits for medical leave, family caregiving, bonding, and safe leave. Funded through payroll contributions.

laws.name: Illinois Victims’ Economic Security and Safety Act (VESSA)
laws.description: Provides job-protected leave for victims of domestic violence, sexual violence, or stalking to seek medical care, counseling, legal assistance, or safety services.

laws.name: Illinois School Visitation Rights Act
laws.description: Provides job-protected leave for parents and guardians to attend school conferences or classroom activities.

laws.name: Illinois State Employee Sick Leave
laws.description: Provides paid sick leave for eligible Illinois state employees for personal illness or injury.
